title.narrative: Financial support note (grant) Contribution to the International Committee of the Red Cross’s appeal to meet the increasing humanitarian needs due to the crisis in Gaza

description.narrative: - Providing medicines and medical supplies needed by the health sector 2- Providing drinking water to displaced Palestinians affected by the war 3- Providing tents for the displaced 4- Supporting food security for displaced Palestinians affected by the war

1 The project aims to support the programs and activities of the International Committee of the Red Cross in all humanitarian sectors in the Gaza Strip, as the grant will provide support for the organization’s activities in the health, water, environmental sanitation and nutrition sectors, in addition to activities dedicated to the displaced, including urgent relief and shelter.

The project is a memorandum of financial support for all humanitarian sectors in which the International Committee of the Red Cross works in the Gaza Strip, including health, water, sanitation and nutrition.
